parts.name: Arc
parts.description: An arc mark for pie and donut charts. It makes one `<path>` per row, a slice of a circle.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows of this mark. Without it, the mark uses the data of the root.

props.name: x
props.description: The x channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: y
props.description: The y channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: series
props.description: The series channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the series of this mark, when it has no series channel. The names of the slices
and the data table show it. The mark draws only the first series.

props.name: inner
props.description:
The radius of the hole, as a fraction of the radius of the circle. The default is 0: a pie
chart. A value of 0.6 makes a donut chart.

props.name: labels
props.description:
Shows a text in the middle of each slice. `true` writes the value in the format of the y
channel; a function writes the text of each point. A text that is wider than its slice does
not show. The labels are hidden from assistive technology: the name of each slice already
has the value. The default is `false`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the group of the mark.

dataAttributes.name: data-mark
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the mark. The value is `arc`.

dataAttributes.name: data-series
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the series. The value is the name of the series.

dataAttributes.name: data-category
dataAttributes.description: On each slice and each label. The value is the x value of the row.

dataAttributes.name: data-arc-labels
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the labels.

dataAttributes.name: data-point
dataAttributes.description: On each point: a circle, a rect for a bar, or a path for a dot or a slice.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: On the point that has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: On the focused point, when the focus came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: On the selected point. The point also has `aria-current="true"`.
